movies.title: Meeting the Buddha
movies.plot: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

movies.tagline: The incredible story of an ordinary Russian teacher who exposed Putin's propaganda machine.

movies.title: Corpus Delicti

In the fight for truth and justice, Mia begins to question the system and becomes the hunted herself.

movies.title: Camouflage
movies.plot: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

movies.title: Don Camillo und Peppone
movies.altTitle: Le petit monde de Don Camillo
movies.plot: In a village of the Po valley where the earth is hard and life miserly, the priest and the communist mayor are always fighting to be the head of the community. If in secret, they admired and liked each other, politics still divided them as it is dividing the country. And when the mayor wants his "People's House"; the priest wants his "Garden City" for the poor. Division exist between the richest and the poorest, the pious and the atheists and even between lovers. But if the people are hard as the country, they are good in the bottom of there heart.

movies.title: Lovebox
movies.plot: A society without money or competition: AfrikaBurn, the largest regional event inspired by the world-famous Burning Man, becomes the setting for a unique experiment. In the middle of the South African desert, an eclectic group of friends sets up their LOVEBOX spaceship, inviting visitors on a journey to the stars — and into themselves. Inside the LOVEBOX, two strangers meet for a few minutes and explore a question about love. Their encounters give rise to unexpected moments of connection and self-discovery. When the dust of the festival settles, the friends set out to bring the magic of the LOVEBOX into everyday life. But can the openness and sense of connection they experienced at AfrikaBurn survive beyond its temporary utopia?

movies.title: A Sad and Beautiful World
movies.plot: Across three decades of passion, loss, and hope, Nino and Yasmina are bound by a magnetic relationship. Torn between love and survival, they must decide whether to build a family in Lebanon or leave their home despite tragedies.

movies.title: Celui qui doit mourir He Who Must Die
movies.criticTitle: Celui qui doit mourir He Who Must Die
sourceTitles: Celui qui doit mourir He Who Must Die
movies.plot: 1920s Greece is occupied by the Turks. A country in turmoil with entire villages uprooted. A small community conduct their annual Passion Play. The leading citizens, under auspices of the Patriarch, choose the actors: a stuttering shepherd as Jesus, the town butcher as Judas, the town prostitute as Mary Magdalene, and so on. As the story unfolds, the Passion becomes a reality.

movies.title: Die Fotografin
movies.plot: The true story of photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller, a fashion model who became an acclaimed war correspondent for Vogue magazine during World War II.
movies.tagline: Some wounds you cannot see.

movies.title: Die Tribute von Panem - Catching Fire
movies.criticTitle: Die Tribute von Panem - Catching Fire
sourceTitles: Die Tribute von Panem - Catching Fire
movies.plot: After surviving the Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta struggle with the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem. Forced back into the spotlight, they become symbols of hope and resistance while the Capitol prepares a new and deadly challenge that will change the future of the nation forever.
movies.tagline: Remember who the enemy is.

movies.title: Shin Godzilla
movies.plot: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens.  A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower.  But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.
movies.tagline: A god incarnate. A city doomed.

movies.title: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
movies.criticTitle: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
sourceTitles: Vertigo - Aus dem Reich der Toten
movies.plot: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.
movies.tagline: Alfred Hitchcock engulfs you in a whirlpool of terror and tension!

movies.title: Trick 'r Treat - Die Nacht der Schrecken
movies.criticTitle: Trick 'r Treat - Die Nacht der Schrecken
sourceTitles: Trick 'r Treat - Die Nacht der Schrecken
movies.plot: Four interwoven stories that occur on Halloween: an everyday high school principal has a secret life as a serial killer; a college virgin might have just met the one guy for her; a group of teenagers pull a mean prank, and a bitter old recluse receives an uninvited guest.
movies.tagline: Poison, drowning, claw, or knife. So many ways to take a life.

movies.title: Whistleblower
movies.plot: A great-nephew of Lumumba exposes corruption in the Congo. US drone pilot reveals that innocent people are systematically being killed in attacks. Marc Bauder profiles people who expose widespread injustices—accompanied by Panama Papers authors Frederik Obermaier and Bastian Obermayer, as well as whistleblower advocate Delphine Halgand-Mishra. S.B.

movies.title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.criticTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
sourceTitles: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.originalTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.plot: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.
movies.tmdbTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.tagline: Billie Eilish and James Cameron reinvent the concert experience.

movies.title: The Party: Nature Morte
movies.plot: The eponymous party is hosted by Queenie and Burrs, long-term lovers who are rapidly growing apart.

movies.title: Der Himmel über Berlin
movies.plot: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.
movies.tagline: There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.plot: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
movies.tagline: See how far it goes.

movies.title: The Uprising - Für die Freiheit
movies.plot: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
movies.tagline: Rise or die.

movies.title: Lancelot, Ritter der Königin
movies.plot: Having failed in their quest for the Holy Grail, the knights of the Round Table return to Camelot, their number reduced to a mere handful. Seeing a rift developing between Lancelot and Mordred, Arthur urges his knights to bury their differences and become friends. However, the King is unaware that Lancelot is having an affair with his queen, Guinevere. Lancelot is torn between his duty to his king and his love for the queen, whilst Mordred is determined to use his infidelity to destroy him.

movies.title: Das Leben als Erwachsene
movies.plot: Irene lives in Rome. When her mother ask to, she go back to Rimini, her hometown, to take care of her autistic brother, Omar. She soon discover that Omar knows very well what to expect from the future, but in order to achieve his dreams, he need to be independent, which is why Irene begins a tender crash course to teach him adult life.

movies.title: Herbstgeschichte
movies.plot: Magali, forty-something, is a winemaker and a widow: she loves her work but feels lonely. Her friends Rosine  and Isabelle both want secretly to find a husband for Magali.

movies.title: Dangerous Minds - Wilde Gedanken
movies.plot: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind. When Johnson returns to the classroom, she does so armed with a no-nonsense attitude informed by her military training and a fearless determination to better the lives of her students -- no matter what the cost.
movies.tagline: She broke the rules... and changed their lives.

movies.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
movies.plot: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.
movies.tagline: The hardest part of ending is starting again.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.plot: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.tagline: Evil found a way out.

movies.title: Traces of Justice
movies.plot: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2 - Zauberhafte Schwestern
movies.plot: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.
movies.tagline: Everything you've witched for.

movies.title: In the Mood for Love
movies.plot: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.
movies.tagline: Feel the heat, keep the feeling burning, let the sensation explode.

movies.title: Manche mögen's heiß
movies.plot: In Prohibition-era Chicago, musicians Joe and Jerry witness a mob hit, and flee the state in an all-female band disguised as Josephine and Daphne, but further complications set in.
movies.tagline: The movie too HOT for words!

movies.title: Pressure
movies.plot: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
movies.tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.

movies.title: Der Exorzist
movies.plot: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
movies.tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.

movies.title: Der Pfandleiher
movies.plot: A Jewish pawnbroker, a victim of Nazi persecution, loses all faith in his fellow man until he realizes too late the tragedy of his actions.
movies.tagline: The Most Talked About Picture!

movies.title: Free at Heart
movies.plot: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

movies.title: Sinn und Sinnlichkeit
movies.plot: The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.
movies.tagline: Lose your heart and come to your senses.

movies.title: Klandestin
movies.plot: Richard, an artist, now lives in Tangier. With his help, the young Moroccan Malik manages to reach Europe, the destination of his dreams. That's where Mathilda, a conservative politician, hides him. Amina, Mathilda's assistant, who finally wants to leave her Moroccan roots behind, is called in as a "mediator" to resolve the problem.

movies.title: Hass
movies.plot: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
movies.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

movies.title: Trainspotting - Neue Helden
movies.plot: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.
movies.tagline: Choose life.

movies.title: Bitteres Fest
movies.plot: In 2004, advertising director Elsa Rosado faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, filmmaker Raúl Durán turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and those closest to him.
movies.tagline: You’re confusing fiction with reality.

movies.title: Etwas ganz Besonderes
movies.plot: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

movies.title: Hirten
movies.plot: A young Montreal advertising executive, converted to a Provençal shepherd, has various misadventures with a civil servant who has cavalierly quit her job.

movies.title: Watching People Watching Birds
movies.plot: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

movies.title: Barfuß durch die Hölle
movies.originalTitle: 人間の條件　第１部純愛篇／第２部激怒篇
movies.plot: After handing in a report on the treatment of Chinese colonial labor, Kaji is offered the post of labour chief at a large mining operation in Manchuria, which also grants him exemption from military service. He accepts and moves with his newlywed wife Michiko, but when he tries to put his ideas of more humane treatment into practice, he finds himself at odds with scheming officials, cruel foremen, and the military police.
movies.tmdbTitle: The Human Condition I: No Greater Love
movies.tagline: The Immortal Story.

movies.title: Eine Frau, von der man spricht
movies.criticTitle: Eine Frau, von der man spricht
sourceTitles: Eine Frau, von der man spricht
movies.plot: After living a traumatic experience in Tokyo, Yukiko returns to Kyoto, where Hatsuko, her mother, runs a brothel, which upsets Yukiko very much.

movies.title: Golden Eighties
movies.plot: In a lively shopping center, proprietors and customers are bustling, including three women vying for a man's heart with song and dance.

movies.title: Pale Flower
movies.plot: A recently released gangster has to cope with the recent shifts of power between gangs, while taking care of a thrill-seeking young woman, who got in bad company while gambling.

movies.title: The Garden of Women
movies.plot: A student at a woman's university takes a controversial action against the school's old-fashioned doctrines.

movies.title: All my Sisters
movies.plot: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

movies.title: Für immer 16
movies.plot: Charlotte, Helena, and Oskar haven't really been in touch since their experimental filmmaking group disbanded. A shared vacation aims to reunite the bitterly estranged trio, but envy and jealousy soon flare up again. Things get really complicated when Rudolph joins the group and they decide to make a film about a female serial killer.

movies.title: Lebensansichten eines Huhns
movies.plot: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

movies.title: Pans Labyrinth
movies.plot: In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious labyrinth, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.
movies.tagline: Innocence has a power evil cannot imagine.

movies.title: The Love That Remains
movies.plot: Anna and Magnús are separating, working out how best to navigate breaking up without confusing their three children. Over the course of one year, life continues, in many ways, as normal, with each change of season occasioning little differences at home and in the surrounding landscape.

movies.title: Das Hohelied der Liebe
movies.plot: A well-off young woman decides to become a nun, joining a convent that rehabilitates female prisoners. Through their program, she meets a woman named Thérèse who refuses any help because she says she was innocent of the crime she was convicted for. After being released from prison, Thérèse murders the actual perpetrator of the crime and comes to seek sanctuary in the convent.

movies.title: Das Kabinett des Dr. Caligari
movies.plot: A delirious young woman feels trapped in a remote mansion at the mercy of a madman.
movies.tagline: To The Unshockables: IT SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS

movies.title: Der Mieter - Eine Geschichte aus dem Londoner Nebel
movies.criticTitle: Der Mieter - Eine Geschichte aus dem Londoner Nebel
sourceTitles: Der Mieter - Eine Geschichte aus dem Londoner Nebel
movies.plot: A quiet and inconspicuous man rents an apartment in Paris where he finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.
movies.tagline: Apartment for rent: Quiet building. Furnished. 2 rooms. Previous tenant committed suicide.

movies.title: Der Zirkus
movies.plot: Charlie, a wandering tramp, becomes a circus handyman - soon the star of the show - and falls in love with the circus owner's stepdaughter.
movies.tagline: The Circus is Here!

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.plot: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the rich and the poor, the son of the city's mastermind meets a prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.
movies.tagline: There can be no understanding between the hands and the brain unless the heart acts as mediator.

movies.title: Zum Beispiel Balthasar
movies.plot: The story of a donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.

movies.title: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.criticTitle: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
sourceTitles: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.plot: Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, had already labelled events in Gaza a genocide back in March 2024. Following her lead, this piece takes us deep into the heart of the institution’s crisis, as it struggles with its inability to stop the massacre of civilians.

movies.title: Hard Boiled
movies.plot: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.
movies.tagline: As a cop, he has brains, brawn, and an instinct to kill.

movies.title: Drishyam - The Conclusion

cinemas.name: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

11:10.cinema: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe
UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

movies.plot: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.
movies.tagline: Visuals Can Be Deceptive

movies.title: Rodychi
movies.plot: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.

movies.title: Jailer
movies.plot: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

movies.title: Wise Women - Fünf Hebammen, fünf Kulturen
movies.criticTitle: Wise Women - Fünf Hebammen, fünf Kulturen
sourceTitles: Wise Women - Fünf Hebammen, fünf Kulturen
movies.plot: Midwives usually attend more than a thousand births in their lifetime, be it in hospitals, at birth centers, or in homes. The personal stories of midwives from Ethiopia to Brazil, Austria to Nepal, and Morocco become a mirror that reflects the political and economic situation of women, their status, and demands in society, from the perspective of these wise women who are the first to see us in this world.

movies.title: Mond
movies.plot: Sarah, a former professional kickboxer from Vienna, accepts an offer to work as a personal trainer for a rich family in the Middle East. She finds herself in a foreign world, in a palace behind walls and cut off from the internet, where the sisters are under surveillance around the clock. They have no interest in learning to box. So why has Sarah been brought here?

movies.title: The Testament of Ann Lee
movies.plot: The extraordinary true legend of Ann Lee, founder of the devotional sect known as the Shakers, who preached gender and social equality and was revered by her followers as the female Christ.
movies.tagline: The Earth will shake and tremble.

movies.title: Sternbrücke Forever
movies.plot: A declaration of love to an edifice and its people, and a tirade against urban politics. Mehmet sells falafel, Martina has a kiosk and Stefan repairs cars. And every weekend, young people fill the clubs under the Sternbrücke – one of more than a hundred old railway bridges in Hamburg. But its time is up: the plan is to take down the bridge and replace it.

movies.title: Las lineas discontinuas
movies.plot: Bea is a middle-aged woman going through divorce. Denís is a young trans man who breaks into her house. Rather than turning him in to the police, she decides to spend the next few days getting to know him.

movies.title: Woolly - Schaf dir das Glück
movies.plot: The director follows her sister Rakel as she takes over the family farm; she will be the fourth generation to run the farm. With her wife Ida, she is packing up her life as a musician and heading north. Rakel is enthusiastic, but she is also aware that there is a lot she doesn’t know how to handle. Her wife Ida has never lived on a farm before and will also have to find her place in this new everyday life and this unfamiliar work. Rakel’s father has been a farmer for 40 years and knows the challenges ahead of her: years when spring never arrives, summers with significant losses to predators, poor harvests, and sheep on the run.

movies.title: Die Erde singt
movies.plot: A cinematic poem with an impressive soundtrack that complements and completes the cinematic sketches of the folk culture of the Slovak nation previously made by ethno-photographer and director Karel Plicka. With its perfectly constructed dramaturgy, the documentary follows the beauty of the natural cycle of the seasons and shows peasant life in an isolated village in the Carpathian mountains of Slovakia from the end of winter through spring and summer to the traditional harvesting methods of autumn. This creates a tribute to traditional culture and the secular connection between man and nature. The aesthetically extraordinary visual representation of folklore comes to life through the editing technique influenced by the Soviet avant-garde and is complemented by poetic intertitles by the Slovak poet Ján Smrek.

movies.title: The Party - Nature Morte
movies.plot: A thirteen-year-old French girl deals with moving to a new city and school in Paris, while at the same time her parents are getting a divorce.

movies.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
movies.plot: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.
movies.tagline: Claim your space.

movies.title: Bigana
movies.plot: A mild-mannered farm laborer becomes enraged when the landowner's spoiled son forces the laborer's wife to sing for a foreign guest.

movies.title: B-Movie: Lust & Sound in West-Berlin 1979-1989
movies.plot: The wild West Berlin of the 1980s became the creative melting pot of pop subcultures: music, art and chaos. Before the Iron Curtain fell, anything and everything seemed possible.
movies.tagline: If you can remember the 80's, you weren't there!

movies.title: Spaziergang nach Syrakus
movies.plot: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

movies.title: Livres! Bücher!
movies.originalTitle: 書を捨てよ町へ出よう
movies.plot: An experimental, psychedelic odyssey through Japanese subculture experienced via the eyes of a disillusioned young man, who must contend with intense familial dysfunction, psychosexual alienation, and existentialist malaise.
movies.tmdbTitle: Throw Away Your Books, Rally in the Streets

movies.title: Ghostland - Reise ins Land der Geister
movies.criticTitle: Ghostland - Reise ins Land der Geister
sourceTitles: Ghostland - Reise ins Land der Geister
movies.plot: A mother of two inherits a home from her aunt. On the first night in the new home she is confronted with murderous intruders and fights for her daughters’ lives. Sixteen years later the daughters reunite at the house, and that is when things get strange...
movies.tagline: You really thought you’ve been scared?

movies.title: Exhibition on Screen: Frida Kahlo
movies.plot: She was a prolific self-portraitist, using the canvas as a mirror through all stages of her turbulent and, at times, tragic life. This highly engaging film takes us on a journey through the life of one of the most prevalent female icons: Frida Kahlo. Displaying a treasure trove of colour and a feast of vibrancy on screen, this personal and intimate film offers privileged access to her works and highlights the source of her feverish creativity, her resilience and her unmatched lust for life, men, women, politics and her cultural heritage.
movies.tagline: The icon, the artist.
